privacyPolicy.title: Черновик русского: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: Черновик русского: This Privacy Policy explains what information Toolars collects, how we use it, and the choices you have. Toolars is built local-first: traditional calculators and PDF tools run in your browser and do not upload your input unless an AI or cloud step is explicitly enabled.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Information we collect
paragraphs: Черновик русского: Account information. When you sign in with Google, we receive your Google account ID, name, and email address as returned by Google. We use these to identify your workspace and sync your saved collections, history, and settings.

Черновик русского: Content you process. Traditional calculators (BMI, mortgage, loan, retirement, and all VitalCalc tools) process your input entirely in your browser. The values you enter never leave your device. PDF tools marked Local process files in your browser; when an AI summarize or cloud step is enabled, the relevant content is sent to the configured provider only after you grant explicit AI consent.
Черновик русского: Usage data. We collect aggregated, anonymized analytics about which tools are used and errors encountered, so we can improve reliability. We do not sell or rent this data.

Черновик русского: Cookies and local storage. We use a minimal set of cookies and local storage entries: a session cookie when you are signed in, an AI consent preference, a cookie consent choice, and your theme/appearance preference. See the Cookies section below.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: How we use your information
paragraphs: Черновик русского: To provide the tools and features you request, including saving your workspace history and collections to your account.
Черновик русского: To operate AI steps that you explicitly enable, sending only the content required for that step to the configured AI provider.
Черновик русского: To maintain the security and integrity of the service, detect abuse, and comply with legal obligations.
Черновик русского: We do not use your information to train AI models, and we do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: AI consent and data processing
paragraphs: Черновик русского: Toolars labels every step as Local, Cloud, or AI. Steps marked Local never transmit your data. Steps marked AI or Cloud require your explicit consent before any content is sent to a provider.

Черновик русского: Your AI consent choice is recorded per workspace. You can review and revoke AI consent at any time from Settings → Privacy & AI. Revoking consent disables AI and cloud steps until you re-enable them.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Cookies
paragraphs: Черновик русского: Toolars uses the following categories of cookies and local storage:
Черновик русского: Strictly necessary. The signed session cookie (when signed in) is required for authentication and cannot be disabled.
Черновик русского: Preferences. Your AI consent choice, cookie consent choice, and appearance preference are stored locally so the site remembers them on your next visit.
Черновик русского: Analytics. Optional, anonymized analytics run only if you accept them in the cookie consent banner. You can withdraw analytics consent at any time.
Черновик русского: You can clear preferences and analytics storage at any time using your browser settings or from Settings → Privacy & AI.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Data retention
paragraphs: Черновик русского: We retain your account information and workspace data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we remove your personal data within 30 days.

Черновик русского: AI consent and run logs are retained to provide an auditable record of your consent choices, as required for accountability under GDPR Article 7(1). You can export these logs from Settings → Privacy & AI.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Your privacy rights
paragraphs: Черновик русского: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights over your personal data:
Черновик русского: Access. Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Черновик русского: Rectification. Ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
Черновик русского: Erasure. Request deletion of your personal data (the 'right to be forgotten').
Черновик русского: Restriction and objection. Ask us to restrict or stop processing your data.
Черновик русского: Data portability. Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
Черновик русского: Withdraw consent. Withdraw your AI, analytics, or cookie consent at any time without affecting processing carried out before withdrawal.

Черновик русского: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at the address below. We respond within 30 days. If you are in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, or California, these rights are guaranteed under the GDPR and CCPA respectively.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: International data transfers
paragraphs: Черновик русского: When you enable an AI or cloud step, your content may be processed by providers located outside your country of residence, including the United States. We rely on standard contractual clauses and provider data processing agreements to ensure appropriate safeguards for such transfers.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Children's privacy
paragraphs: Черновик русского: Toolars is not directed at children under 13 (or the equivalent minimum age in your jurisdiction) and we do not knowingly collect personal data from them. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: Черновик русского: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The 'last updated' date at the top reflects the most recent change. Material changes will be highlighted on the site at least seven days before they take effect.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Contact us
paragraphs: Черновик русского: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to exercise your data rights, email privacy@toolars.app. Include 'Privacy Request' in the subject line.

termsOfService.title: Черновик русского: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: Черновик русского: These Terms of Service govern your use of Toolars. By accessing or using the site, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Use of the service
paragraphs: Черновик русского: You may use Toolars for lawful personal and commercial purposes. Traditional calculators and PDF tools are free to use during the beta.
Черновик русского: You are responsible for the content you process and for ensuring you have the rights to use any files you upload for AI or cloud steps.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Черновик русского: You agree not to: use the service for any unlawful purpose; upload content that infringes the rights of others; attempt to access, disrupt, or reverse-engineer systems you are not authorized to access; use automated means to scrape or overload the service; or submit malicious files or prompts designed to exploit the AI features.
Черновик русского: Violations may result in suspension of your account and, where applicable, referral to the relevant authorities.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: AI features and consent
paragraphs: Черновик русского: AI and cloud steps are optional and require your explicit consent before any content is processed by a third-party provider. You are responsible for reviewing which steps are AI-assisted before enabling them.
Черновик русского: AI-generated output may be inaccurate. You are responsible for verifying AI results before relying on them. Toolars is not liable for decisions made based on AI output.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Your content
paragraphs: Черновик русского: You retain ownership of the content you process with Toolars. By using cloud or AI steps, you grant the configured provider a license to process that content solely to provide the step you requested.
Черновик русского: Traditional calculator and local PDF tool inputs remain on your device and are not licensed to Toolars or any provider.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Accounts
paragraphs: Черновик русского: You are responsible for safeguarding the account credentials provided by your chosen sign-in method and for all activity under your account. Notify us immediately at security@toolars.app if you suspect unauthorized access.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Fees and beta
paragraphs: Черновик русского: Traditional tools are free during the beta. AI and cloud steps may consume credits or incur charges when paid plans launch. Material changes to pricing will be announced at least 14 days in advance.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Disclaimer of warranties
paragraphs: Черновик русского: The service is provided 'as is' and 'as available' without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied. Calculator results are provided for informational purposes and are not medical, financial, or legal advice. Always consult a qualified professional for such advice.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: Черновик русского: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Toolars shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or any loss of profits or data, arising out of your use of the service.

sections.heading: Черновик русского: Indemnification

borderline.label: Пограничный диапазон
borderline.interpretation: HOMA-IR находится в пограничном диапазоне (2.0-2.5). Обратите внимание на питание и физическую активность, чтобы снизить риск прогрессирования.

resistance.label: Инсулинорезистентность
resistance.interpretation: HOMA-IR выше 2.5, что может указывать на инсулинорезистентность. Проконсультируйтесь с эндокринологом и действуйте активно.
